heuristics: random-mapping behaviour of the r-adding walk with negation map (Teske 2001); analytic only, 7% probability margin
fruitless-cycle rate model 2(2l/R)^l under table-index independence (Bos et al. 2010; BLS 2011)
distinguished-point test independent of table index
M=220/A=24 conservative scalar AArch64 estimates, not measured P-256 kernels
